capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: CWTools needs the mod and the game install on a real file system to index them.

configuration.title: CWTools configuration
configuration.cwtools.trace.server.descr: Traces the communication between VSCode and the language server.
configuration.cwtools.localisation.langu: Languages to validate localisation against. Only the listed languages are checked, so an English-only mod isn't flagged for missing French/German/… translations the base game happens to ship. Default: English.
configuration.cwtools.localisation.hover: Show hover localisation in every configured language instead of just the first one.
configuration.cwtools.errors.ignore.desc: Diagnostic codes to suppress everywhere, e.g. CW100 (list of error/warning IDs).
configuration.cwtools.errors.ignorefiles: File names to exclude from the workspace (not load into cwtools, so references into them won't resolve), e.g. README.txt, credits.txt.
configuration.cwtools.rules_folder.descr: A folder containing custom rules to use
configuration.cwtools.ignore_patterns.de: File paths to ignore (not load into cwtools), list of glob patterns
configuration.cwtools.cache.eu4.descript: Path to a vanilla EU4 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.hoi4.descrip: Path to a vanilla HOI4 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.stellaris.de: Path to a vanilla Stellaris install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.ck2.descript: Path to a vanilla CK2 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.imperator.de: Path to a vanilla Imperator: Rome install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.vic2.descrip: Path to a vanilla Victoria 2 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.ck3.descript: Path to a vanilla CK3 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.vic3.descrip: Path to a vanilla Victoria 3 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.cache.eu5.descript: Path to a vanilla EU5 install. Used to resolve base-game references so they aren't flagged as unknown. Usually auto-detected from Steam.
configuration.cwtools.graph.zoomSensitiv: Control scroll wheel zoom sensitivity, <1 reduces sensitivity, >1 increases sensitivity
configuration.cwtools.hover.debug.descri: Show raw rule classification (field / type / scope) in hover tooltips. For extension developers; off by default.
configuration.cwtools.hover.scopeDisplay: What scope a hover tooltip shows: the ambient scope the field is in (context), or additionally the scope it resolves to (resolved).
Show the ambient scope the hovered field is in.
Also show the scope the hovered link or FROM/ROOT/PREV keyword resolves to.
configuration.cwtools.inlayHints.locTitl: Show the localised title inline after a value that names a known entity, so an event or focus id reads as its in-game name without hovering. Reload the window after changing this.
Show the scope a scope-changing key resolves to, inline after the key. The bundled server does not produce these hints yet, so turning this on currently shows nothing. Reload the window after changing this.
configuration.cwtools.profiling.descript: Launch the language server with profiling on. Emits per-phase timing and memory (RSS) to the CWTools output channel and keeps a buffer you can save with 'cwtools: Export profiling log'. Reload the window after changing this. Slightly slower; leave off for normal use.
Minutes between background re-index passes that keep the index fresh during long sessions. Runs only while idle. 0 disables.
Seconds of inactivity before a background re-index pass may start, so a rescan doesn't compete with what you're typing. 0 lets a pass start immediately.
